Product Features

  • Generous U-Shaped Design – Maximum Use of SpaceThis generous U-shaped 4-seater sofa offers optimal use of space while creating an open, inviting living area. The U-shape allows for clear zoning and offers enough space for families, guests and relaxing moments together.
  • The high-quality corduroy fabric inspires with a pleasantly soft feel and elegant look. It feels gentle on the skin, is hard-wearing and easy to care for at the same time – ideal for daily use in modern households with high comfort requirements.
  • Stylish backrest – modern & harmonious overall appearanceThe stylishly designed backrest gives the sofa a modern and aesthetic appearance. Their curved shape not only supports the spine, but also creates a harmonious design that can be effortlessly integrated into different living styles.
  • Softly padded seat cushions – long-lasting comfortThe softly padded seat cushions ensure a particularly pleasant sitting experience. Thanks to their high-quality filling, they retain their shape, provide long-lasting support and allow relaxed sitting for longer periods of time.
  • Stable Sofa Legs – High Load-Bearing Capacity & Safe UseThe sturdily constructed sofa legs made of robust material ensure a high load-bearing capacity and ensure lasting stability. Even with daily intensive use, the sofa remains reliably stable and offers a secure seating feeling.
  • The two spacious chaise lounges are ideal for reading, watching TV or relaxing loungers. They create personal comfort zones in which you can lean back, stretch out and completely relax.
  • Versatile – Suitable for every living situationThanks to its timeless design and versatile U-shape, the sofa can be used in almost any living concept – whether living room, family room, It blends in harmoniously and noticeably improves living comfort.
